name: Dimensions Display
summary: Target-formatted native measurement list with an optional explanatory visual and optional canonical exclusive unit choice.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Generic measurement-presentation container emitted only for a non-empty valid measurement set.

anatomy.name: visual
anatomy.description: Optional target-owned native figure containing truthful media/diagram content and redundant visual annotations.

anatomy.name: visualAnnotations
anatomy.description: Optional redundant visible annotations; exact values remain available in the required textual list.

anatomy.name: content
anatomy.description: Layout wrapper for the optional canonical control and required measurement list.

anatomy.name: measurements
anatomy.description: Native description list containing one active coherent target-formatted measurement set.

anatomy.name: measurement
anatomy.description: Repeated native description-list group containing one visible quantity term and value.

anatomy.name: value
anatomy.description: Directionally isolated complete formatted value, including its target-supplied unit and qualifiers.

anatomy.name: unitControls
anatomy.description: Optional canonical Segmented Control whose native radio value is coordinated by the target.

variants.name: default
variants.description: One active target-formatted measurement set with optional visual and unit choice.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Intrinsic component-width response with no public size or breakpoint property.

states.name: default
states.description: Passive measurement presentation. Any checked unit state belongs to the composed Segmented Control.

behavior.name: requiredMeasurements
behavior.description: Render only complete target-formatted name/value groups; no valid groups omits the complete Dimensions root.

behavior.name: targetFormattedValues
behavior.description: Targets own source quantities, unit system, conversion, precision, rounding, locale, tolerance and the complete active formatted strings. Dimensions performs no arithmetic or parsing.

behavior.name: unitChoiceComposition
behavior.description: If present, canonical Segmented Control owns one exclusive native choice and its keyboard/focus behavior; the target coordinates that semantic value with a complete formatted measurement/annotation set.

behavior.name: controlledUncontrolledBoundary
behavior.description: Dimensions receives the active rendered content and owns no second selected-unit store. A target may control or initialize the canonical radio group and replace the active content from its authoritative source.

behavior.name: passiveUpdateBoundary
behavior.description: The measurement list is not a live region by default. Targets own any user-research-backed concise result announcement without duplicating every value.

properties.name: visual
properties.description: Optional target-owned informative visual/diagram and redundant annotations; exact values remain in text.

properties.name: measurements
properties.description: Required non-empty target-formatted native name/value composition; no raw-number or unit schema is prescribed.

properties.name: unitControls
properties.description: Optional canonical Segmented Control; the target owns selected value and complete-set replacement.

accessibility: Expose every measurement as a complete visible native description-list name/value group, even when a visual repeats it.
Keep the quantity name explicit and keep the target-formatted unit adjacent to its numerical value; do not rely on position, lines or image scale.
Give informative visual media a truthful text alternative and hide fully redundant annotations from assistive technology.
Use direction isolation and tabular numerals without truncating localized values or qualifiers.
If unit choice is present, compose canonical Segmented Control with a visible legend, same-name native radios, exactly one active value and native keyboard behavior.
Do not duplicate selected-unit state with independent aria-pressed buttons and do not make the complete measurement list a live region by default.

web.notes: Generic container, native dl/div/dt/dd/bdi measurement groups, optional figure and canonical radio-backed Segmented Control composition; R5 adds no neutral runtime.

shopify.notes: Requires approved product/variant quantity source, unit/precision/locale policy, merchant validation and first consumer before Liquid/schema.
